requirements: 实现 3 个核心类: [ObsidianSyncService, VaultWatcher, ConflictResolver]
支持 2 个同步模式: [one-way (niko → obsidian), two-way (bidirectional)]
使用 watchdog 监听文件变化: .writing/ 和 vault 目录
创建 1 个配置文件: config/obsidian.yaml
创建 1 个测试文件: tests/unit/services/test_obsidian_sync.py
acceptance: 同步 .writing/memories/ 到 Obsidian vault: 验证 sync() 方法复制文件
支持 2 种冲突策略: [latest-wins, manual]: 验证 ConflictResolver.resolve() 正确处理
文件变化实时同步: 验证 watchdog 触发 on_modified 事件
支持 Obsidian frontmatter 保留: 验证 YAML frontmatter 不被破坏
测试覆盖率 ≥75%: 验证 pytest --cov=src/services/obsidian_sync --cov-report=term | grep '75%'

patterns: File watcher → Change detection → Conflict resolution → Sync

pre_analysis.action: Load context package for artifact paths
Analyze MemoryManager YAML frontmatter format for Obsidian compatibility
Analyze existing file_sync.py for watchdog patterns

implementation_approach.title: Implement ObsidianSyncService core classes
modification_points: 创建 1 个新文件: src/services/obsidian_sync.py (预估 400 行)
实现 ObsidianSyncService: 主入口，管理同步逻辑
实现 VaultWatcher: 使用 watchdog 监听文件变化
实现 ConflictResolver: 检测冲突并应用解决策略
支持 2 种模式: [one-way (单向同步), two-way (双向同步)]
支持 2 种冲突策略: [latest-wins (最新优先), manual (手动解决)]
logic_flow: 设计 ObsidianSyncService: sync(mode='one-way', conflict_strategy='latest-wins')
实现文件映射: .writing/memories/by_date/YYYY/MM/DD/*.md → vault/niko-studio/YYYY-MM-DD/*.md
实现 ConflictResolver: 计算文件 hash，比较 mtime，应用策略
实现 VaultWatcher: watchdog.Observer 监听 .writing/ 和 vault/
实现事件处理: on_created, on_modified, on_deleted → 触发 sync()
保留 YAML frontmatter: 解析 frontmatter，合并 Obsidian 特有字段 (tags, aliases)
实现冲突日志: 记录冲突到 .writing/.logs/sync_conflicts.log
实现同步状态: 记录最后同步时间到 .sync_state.json

implementation_approach.title: Create configuration file
modification_points: 创建 config/obsidian.yaml: 定义 vault 路径、同步模式、冲突策略
logic_flow: 设计 obsidian.yaml 结构: {vault_path, sync_mode, conflict_strategy, watch_patterns, exclude_patterns}
添加默认配置: vault_path='~/Documents/Obsidian/MyVault', sync_mode='one-way', conflict_strategy='latest-wins'
添加高级选项: watch_patterns=['*.md'], exclude_patterns=['.obsidian/', '.trash/']
实现配置加载: ObsidianSyncService.load_config(config_path)
添加配置验证: 检查 vault_path 是否存在

implementation_approach.title: Write comprehensive unit tests
implementation_approach.description: Test ObsidianSyncService and all sync modes
modification_points: 创建 1 个测试文件: tests/unit/services/test_obsidian_sync.py
实现 8 个测试用例: [test_one_way_sync, test_two_way_sync, test_conflict_latest_wins, test_conflict_manual, test_frontmatter_preservation, test_watcher_triggers, test_file_mapping, test_config_loading]
logic_flow: Setup: 创建临时 .writing/ 和 vault/ 目录，添加测试文件
测试 one-way sync: 验证 .writing/ → vault 单向同步
测试 two-way sync: 验证双向同步，两边修改都被同步
测试冲突解决: 验证 latest-wins 策略选择最新文件
测试 frontmatter 保留: 验证 YAML frontmatter 不被破坏
测试 watcher: mock watchdog，验证文件变化触发 sync
测试文件映射: 验证路径转换正确
测试配置加载: 验证 config/obsidian.yaml 正确解析
Cleanup: 删除临时目录
